column1: # build/nightly/test-hosts.tsv -- the canonical NCZ hardware test fleet for the
#   host  ip  hostname  arch  gpu  kernel  ssh_user  cred_ref  role  smoke  forbidden
#   ssh_user   user the canary connects as (never root for the smoke)
#   cred_ref   where the password/creds come from when pubkey is unavailable
#   smoke      comma list of the smoke steps that apply on this host:
#   forbidden  comma list of things the nightly must NEVER do on this host
# headless only, exact-PID cleanup, never reboot/flash, never kill the desktop
# session, one GPU client at a time (a busy host is SKIPPED, not interrupted).
